I wrote the calculator in Odin under `src/main.odin`, plus `build.sh`, which builds an optimized binary at `./app`. All 6 example cases in `node check.mjs` pass. I also ran these extra checks, and each gave the result the spec calls for:

- **Overflow at the limits:** `(-9223372036854775807 - 1) % -1` gives `0`, while the same with `/` is an error. `-9223372036854775808` is an error because the literal is too large. Multiplying `3037000499` by itself works, and `3037000500` squared overflows.
